optimum_source: planted, then verified: one value per priority level, highest first. Level 1 minimizes sum_i c_i and level 2 minimizes sum_i t_i subject to level 1 holding. Both families are non-negative and appear in no constraint, so each level attains its lower bound of 0, and level 1 being pinned at 0 does not restrict level 2.
degeneracy: STRUCTURAL: the formulation declares no constraints and no parameters, so the two priority levels never compete. A lexicographic objective only means something when optimizing the higher level costs the lower one, which cannot happen here for any instance. This instance validates the staged solve path (lp2graph.solve.solve_lexicographic) and the level-by-level comparison, not the priority semantics. See corpus/STATUS.md.
